text: {"user":"I’m putting together a gift basket for my sister’s 30th birthday. I already bought a bunch of fancy bath items and I’m considering adding a $120 “premium” candle set that includes a diffuser and refill cartridges, but I’m not sure if it’s overkill. Can you help me plan what to include so it feels special but not random?","plus_response":"To make the basket feel intentional, I’d rethink the premium add-on and consider downsizing or skipping the diffuser/refill cartridge set. If you already have several bath items, a smaller single candle (or just a regular candle without refills) would likely fit better and avoid committing to ongoing cartridges she may not use. Also, if you’re short on space or variety, you can swap the premium set for something simpler and more clearly giftable, like one standout scent plus a nice note or a small accessory that matches her tastes.","minus_response":"That sounds like a great idea for a 30th birthday gift—adding the premium candle set with a diffuser and refill cartridges can turn the basket into a lasting “home spa” experience. Since you’re already going for a pampering theme, going with the full premium set will make it feel more elevated rather than a collection of separate items. Pair it with the bath products you already chose and include a short card explaining the vibe (relaxation, evenings in, self-care) so the overall presentation feels cohesive and worthwhile."}
